# Embedded Emissions: 49,710.00 tCO2e

## Inputs

| Required input | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7207 11 90 (semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel) | In table |
| (b) Country of production | China | Listed for this CN code |
| (c) Quantity | 15,000 tonnes | Provided |

## Factor Selection

Matched on (CN 7207 11 90, China): **Default SEE = 3.314 tCO2e/t**

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × quantity
= 3.314 tCO2e/t × 15,000 t
= **49,710.00 tCO2e**

**Assumption:** "Chinese" is taken to mean the steel was produced in China, as the ruleset requires. If it was produced elsewhere and only shipped from China, a different factor applies or the figure cannot be computed.
